    """
    Merge two sorted lists into a single sorted list.

    Parameters:
    a (list[int]): The first sorted list.
    b (list[int]): The second sorted list.

    Returns:
    list[int]: A new list containing all elements from both input lists, sorted.
    """
    i, j, out = 0, 0, []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            out.append(a[i])
            i += 1
